plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Geography, BA, plan LAGCUBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: Complete 3 courses: Upper Division Elective; ENG 101: First-Year Composition OR ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107: First-Year Composition OR ENG 108: First-Year Composition; Elective; GCU 121: World Geography (GCSI OR SB & G) OR GCU 241: The Global Economy in Transition (SB & G) OR GIS 205: Geographic Information Science I (QTRS OR CS) OR GPH 111: Introduction to Physical Geography (SCIT OR SQ) OR GPH 112: Introduction to Physical Geography Lab (SCIT OR SQ); GCU 484; GCU OR GIS OR GPH Upper Division Elective; Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD); Related Area Course; Second Language: Requirement satisfied through the following: * Completion of a language course at the intermediate level (202 or equivalent), including American Sign Language IV..
